changelog:
Vanguard v1.0.29
- All-time leaderboard now counts the blocked traffic you racked up before leaderboards existed; it gets added to your lifetime total. (Weekly boards stay a rolling 7-day window.)
- Leaderboards now scroll: each board shows the top 25 players. Mouse-wheel over a board to scroll through it.
- New setting (Settings > Overlay Details > "Show module icons"). Turn it off to label the overlay badges with their port (3074 / 27K / 30K / 7500) instead of icons.
